checks.scope: divisors at 2^w-1, 2^w, 2^w+1, 2^(w+1)-1, half-word boundary, and small divisors; widths1..12,15,16,31,32,63,64,127; both signs and all three rounding modes

reasoning: Bit-plane lanes encode overlapping low-to-high blocks modulo d; right shift supplies the disjoint upper block, and doubling the represented block length proves all suffix residues.
The quotient bit identity [2*r_(i+1)+bit_i(x)>=d] emits the complete word after the logarithmic prefix stage count.
Conditional bit-plane subtraction and scalar gap=d-b reduction avoid native carry overflow, including d=maxword.
Negative floor, truncation and nearest-even symmetry are correct; thresholds compare r with floor(d/2) without doubling r.
Fixed numerator shifts fit the explicit widened physical working width. Constant physical-limb emulation must handle limb-boundary shifts explicitly.
O(log(2+w)) holds for fixed p,d, not uniformly over growing denominators: the explicit constant is O(bit_length(d)^2). Bit-plane scratch is O(bit_length(d)) ordinary words.
The source framework replacement O(Nw) to O(Nlog(2+w)) is an arithmetic upper-bound improvement under the stated ABI, not a paid Gaussian-profile or kappa improvement.
controls: Existing scientific wrong_weight and wrong_suffix mutations have explicit failing witnesses and remain active under -O.
Out-of-range input and zero divisor are rejected.
requirements: Both logical shifts are primitive in this restricted ABI; the exact Problem1.8 Lean machine derives right shift using division, so no division-free compilation into that machine is claimed.
Working word width includes fixed numerator/denominator guard bits; callers must reserve them physically or charge a constant number of limbs.
Array address headroom must satisfy 2^W >= c*N+c_d; scalar scratch address space also needs 2^W>=c_d.
w is supplied metadata in the executable; automatic width discovery is a separate prescribed option under explicit zero-on-overshift semantics.
Instruction count is a conservative emulated data-operation bound plus separately bounded loop/setup cost, not a processor cycle benchmark.
limitations: No new kappa, missing channel-complement recovery, complete multiplication theorem, Lean kernel audit, hosted CI or independent human review is established.
Primary-literature priority is not certified by this correctness review.
